shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus, layered over the 1px border.

motion.purpose: Button/field state changes; ease-out, no bounce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen — navy fill.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary / Cancel beside the single primary.

components.description: Standard field — 1px border, navy focus ring.

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat surface delineated by a 1px border, generous padding.

components.name: Selectable Chip
components.description: Interest / filter pill; navy fill when selected.

narrative.overview: A calm operational bridge: every instrument legible at a glance, nothing blinking for attention's sake, the whole console trustworthy under load. Deep navy is the structural voice; the surface is quiet and tinted; colour speaks only when it means something. Restrained and flat by default, bilingual EN/AR by construction.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-led, restrained palette; accent <=10% of any screen.
Flat by default; a single soft card shadow, used sparingly.
Three first-class themes: light (default), dark, grey.
Bilingual EN/AR + RTL as a baseline, never an add-on.
Comfortable density with clear one-primary-action hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Bright blue (#007CD8) is links and focus only. Navy carries structure and primary action. Gold is a highlight measured in pixels, not regions.

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never #000 or #fff; neutrals are tinted toward navy (ink #1A2433, neutral #F1F2F2).

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: No giant display type; separate hierarchy by weight and a >=1.25 step, not by inflating sizes.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; lift is a response to state, never decoration.

dos: Do take every colour, font, space, radius, shadow from theme.tokens.css (zero hardcoded hex / font-family).
Do keep the page navy-structural and quiet: one primary action per screen, accent <=10%.
Do build on logical properties (inline-size, margin-inline, padding-block) so Arabic RTL mirrors for free.
Do convey depth by tonal layering and 1px tinted borders; reserve the card shadow for floating surfaces.
Do use SimfDataGrid for every list; use a 3px bright-blue focus ring on every focusable control.
donts: Don't look consumer-playful or casual: no bright rounded-everything, no emoji, no informal microcopy.
Don't ship generic AI-slop SaaS: no identical icon-card grids, no gradient hero-metric template.
Don't go crypto-neon / flashy: no neon-on-black, no glows, no gradients-everywhere.
Don't fall into cluttered legacy-ERP density: no wall-to-wall raw tables, no hierarchy-free cramming.
Don't use a colored border-left/right > 1px as an accent stripe; don't use gradient background-clip:text; don't use glassmorphism by default.
Don't use #000/#fff; don't make gold a status or a fill; don't animate layout properties or add bounce/elastic motion.
